statements.status_notes: The crash is in eu-readelf -z with -x or -p on a crafted file containing a section without a name (https://sourceware.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=32656 and its duplicate https://sourceware.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=32657). It is fixed upstream in elfutils 0.193 by commit 73db9d2021cab9e23fd734b0a76a612d52a6f1db. The published packages are elfutils 0.192 without that change, and both bugs' reproducers still crash eu-readelf from the current amd64 and arm64 packages. Upstream does not consider it a security vulnerability and said so on the bug, citing its security policy (https://sourceware.org/cgit/elfutils/tree/SECURITY), which treats crashes of the elfutils tools on crafted input as ordinary bugs and advises users of the tools and libraries not to run elfutils analysis on untrustworthy input. Debian rates it unimportant (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-1372). Because the crash still reproduces in the published packages, this stays under investigation. Pending: an elfutils build that carries the upstream fix, or a maintainer decision that the input reaching this code is trusted for every program that uses these packages, including other programs that link libelf and libdw.
